message: I am reaching out on behalf of AI Advance Solutions, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), to request a quote for a project involving the removal of existing exterior lighting, installation of new LED marine-grade fixtures, and electrical upgrades such as wiring, conduit, breakers, and photocells. Work will be performed at the Boat House, ANT Building, and light poles, with all materials required to meet marine-environment standards and be approved by the COR.
